name: GT Gold Holdings Limited
summary: GT Gold Holdings Limited, incorporated in 2003 and based in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company that explores, mines and processes gold in China. It holds an interest in the Taizhou gold mine in Tongguan county, Shaanxi province, and also does scientific research and technical work and trade agency sales. It was formerly Grand T G Gold Holdings Limited until October 2024.
